lines.text: David asks the LORD to take up shield and buckler, and to draw the spear and javelin against his pursuers.
David asks that his enemies be like chaff in the wind, driven away by the angel of the LORD.
When his enemies were ill, David put on sackcloth and fasted, but when he stumbled, they gathered in glee.
David asks the Lord to rescue his life from lions and promises to give thanks in the cave of Adullam.
David says his enemies scheme against the priests in the temple, and he asks the LORD not to be silent.

wrong_details.true: those who live quietly in the land
